body.text: A small thing, and I set it down because nobody else will.
I noted the letter Your Grace sent to {param:town} — that they were to be {param:asked}. The governor has continued at {param:did} regardless, and I do not believe he has written to you about it.

I am not accusing him of anything. He gave his reasons out loud and they were not foolish ones; a man who has decided a thing tends to have decided it for a reason. Whether they are reasons you would accept is not for me to say, which is rather my point — you were not asked.
You keep me here to tell you what the post does not. This is that.

tone.text: As to the governor of {param:town}, I am {choice}.

options.text: obliged to you for the notice
glad somebody there writes to me plainly
less pleased with him than I was
done being managed by my own servants

steps.prompt: What he is to do about it

options.label: go on telling me
options.text: Go on telling me. A governor who does not write is a governor I cannot govern, and I would rather hear it from you than not at all.

options.label: that is not your office
options.text: That is not your office. You are there to report a colony, not to carry tales about the men running it.
